thought.title: avgpool2d 8-element Vectorized SIMD Implementation
thought.description: Implemented 8-element vectorized Load/Store with Add/Muls for SIMD processing. Baseline used scalar GetValue/SetValue for each element. Vectorized version processes 8 outputs simultaneously using Vector unit.
thought.reason: Memory-bound pooling operation benefits significantly from vectorization. 8-element SIMD reduces memory access overhead and enables better Vector unit utilization.

runtime.dsl_after: Vector Load/Store + Add/Muls for 8-element SIMD; UB buffers for accumulation staging
